body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Clever raccoon opportunist; notices what is available, practical and amused without trash-can jokes. Voice direction: Medium male tenor with a New York accent and sly nasal bite. Quick practical observations, dry little pauses and a pleased conspiratorial edge; still clear and friendly. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Well, look what's available. The defender moved, so that piece is free to take. No fancy trick needed; just notice what was left loose.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
